City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA

6:00
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Commission Secretary. If at least two Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the Commission Secretary. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.

STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Administrative Support Coordinator
2.
CASE NUMBER: 14-018 CDP FILING DATE: January 21, 2014
APPLICANT: Eric Price
LOCATION: 1405 Rainbow Ridge Lane (APN: 254-181-23).
DESCRIPTION: The applicant requests a Coastal Development Permit for the construction of a new single-family residence on a vacant property.
ZONING: The subject property is located in the Rural Residential 2 (RR-2) zone in the Leucadia Community and within the Hillside/Inland Bluff Overlay (H/IBO) zone and the Coastal Zone.
ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
RECOMMENDATION: Staff recommends that the Planning Commission approve Case No. 14-018 CDP based upon the findings and conditions contained in the draft Resolution of Approval.
STAFF CONTACT: Todd Mierau, Associate Planner
NOTE: THE PLANNING COMMISSION MAY NOT BEGIN A NEW HEARING AFTER
10:00 PM UNLESS APPROVED BY A MAJORITY OF THE COMMISSION.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
3.
SPECIAL PRESENTATION Presentation of Appreciation to Virginia Felker for her service to the City and the
Community of Encinitas.
REGULAR AGENDA
4.
CASE NUMBER: 13-178 PCIN
FILING DATE: September 3, 2013
APPLICANT: Madelyn J. Chaber
LOCATION: 1386 Tennis Club Drive (APN: 262-080-17)
DESCRIPTION: Public Hearing for a Planning Commission Interpretation of what constitutes natural grade for purposes of development.
ZONING/OVERLAYS: The subject property is located in the Residential 3 (R-3) zone, Hillside/Inland Bluff Overlay Zone and the Coastal Zone.
ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The interpretation of provisions of the Municipal Code by the Planning Commission is not subject to environmental review.
RECOMMENDATION: Staff recommends the Planning Commission determine that the site contains manufactured slopes and the County of San Diego Historic Topo dated 1960 must be used to determine natural slopes for purposes of measuring building height and slope analysis and density calculations based upon the findings contained in the attached Draft Resolution of Approval.
STAFF CONTACT: Roy Sapa'u, Senior Planner
